review.summary: One validation-target regression was identified in the reviewed committed diff.

findings.summary: The backend test target adds an unintended local database prerequisite.
findings.rationale: The documented default full suite skips integration suites when their database setting is absent. This recipe sets that value to a fixed local database, so the Make validation targets require a reachable database and run migration integration work where the documented command would not.
findings.recommendation: Remove the fixed integration-database setting and delegate directly to the documented default test command. Keep integration testing explicit and scoped to a disposable database.
